buttonizationNotes:
decorateButtons matches p a[href]; requires / ancestor; skips links containing , links not alone in their

, and URL-display links; replaces the emphasis wrapper with the classed anchor. Runs in decorateMain BEFORE block decorate().
autoBlocks: fragments (a[href*=/fragments/]) and widget links (a[href*=/widgets/]) only — NO hero autoblock in this vintage
iconDecoration: decorateIcons(main) fills span.icon.icon- with ; runs before blocks
wrapTextNodes:
decorateBlock runs wrapTextNodes(block): any block cell whose FIRST element child is not P/PRE/UL/OL/PICTURE/TABLE/H1-H6 (e.g. a bare , or a PICTURE followed by more content) gets its ENTIRE cell content wrapped in ONE

. Block decodes must unwrap this artifact (see expandWrapper in the collectors) — found empirically: award plaques rendered empty until handled
emptySectionCollapseNote: metadata block is consumed by the delivery pipeline leaving an empty section div; foundation adds main .section:empty { display: none }
fontsLoad: loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css eagerly on >=900px viewports or when sessionStorage fonts-loaded is set; always in loadLazy
chrome: header/footer blocks loadFragment(getMetadata('nav') || '/nav') and (getMetadata('footer') || '/footer'); this site overrides per page: nav=/flexiloans/nav, footer=/flexiloans/footer
